title: Setup pages: form field, data table, card and confirm dialog
goal: The setup pages use bricks form field, data table, card and dialog
acceptance: Every .field/.hint/field-error/.form-errors uses the bricks form field (errors still shown once touched, hub refusals above the buttons)
Setup tables use the data table pattern; the inline .editor is a bricks card
Delete confirmations use the bricks dialog instead of confirm()
drafts and editor specs pass; .form-grid stays Grover-only
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: nine editors and four tables share the same markup. Not a measurement.
